title: Project display with robotic chassis and poster board
objects_and_counts: Two people are visible standing behind the table in the midground; both are wearing face masks. The person on the left is wearing a black-and-white horizontally striped sweater; the person in the center is wearing a light grey T-shirt.
One small freestanding project sign on the table reads 'Project 19' above a blue panel that reads 'VOTE' (see visible_text).
One large vertical poster board is visible behind and to the right of the two people; it is mounted upright on a support and contains multiple headings and images.

One robotic chassis / assembled device is on the right foreground of the table. The device assembly includes multiple visible wired components and at least four cylindrical wheel/motor assemblies attached around the base (four wheel-like modules are individually distinguishable).
At least two tall round stools are visible in the left background next to another table; their tops and legs are visible but partly cropped by the image frame.
One smaller printed sign or card is visible at left background on another table, but its text is partially cropped and not fully legible.
spatial_relations: The two people stand side-by-side behind the central area of the table; the person in the striped sweater is at the left edge of the pair and the person in the light grey T-shirt is at the center of the image.

The freestanding 'Project 19 / VOTE' sign is placed on the table in front of the poster board and slightly right of the two people; it sits between the people and the robotic device from the camera viewpoint.

The large vertical poster board stands behind and slightly to the right of the people; the poster is taller than the people's torsos and contains stacked sections arranged vertically (headings and small illustrative panels aligned top to bottom).

The robotic chassis is on the right foreground portion of the table, occupying the nearest right-side workspace to the camera; its base is aligned along the front edge of the table and is closer to the camera than the people and poster.
A second table with at least two round stools is located in the left background behind the people; the stools are adjacent to that secondary table surface.
colours_and_materials: The display table surface appears light beige or pale wood in colour and has a smooth matte finish.
The large poster board background is predominantly white with a dark blue header strip at the top and smaller blue panels; printed images and coloured boxes appear on the poster.
The 'VOTE' panel is blue with white lettering and an orange gradient strip at the top where 'Project 19' is printed in white.
The robotic assembly shows metallic silver components and structural elements, with visible wiring in red, black and green; some small plastic parts appear black or white.
The left person's sweater is black with white horizontal stripes; the center person's T-shirt is light grey with a dark chest emblem that includes the text 'BRISKNESS' (see visible_text).
Both people wear disposable face masks—one appears light blue and the other white.
uncertainties: No explicit room name, room number or signage indicating a specific room is legible in the image; therefore the precise location cannot be determined from this image.

Paragraph blocks of small body text on the poster board are mostly unreadable at the photographed resolution; only section headings and single-word captions were legible. Those unreadable blocks are represented as '[unreadable]'.
The exact model or type labels on the robotic components are not legible; small labels or nameplates on the device were inspected but their text could not be transcribed.

The visible count of four cylindrical wheel/motor assemblies is based on individually distinguishable modules in the foreground; occlusion or cropping might hide additional components not visible in the frame.
The small printed sign at left background is partly cropped and its full text cannot be determined from the image.
